specs.value: JBL PROFLORA AquaBasis plus. Vietnamese shops often spell it "Aquabasic Plus".
Ready-to-use long-term nutrient soil laid under the main substrate
Plant nutrients including iron; clay components store nutrients and release them when needed
Contains iron and potassium, mixed with sand and clay
At least 3 years, depending on how densely the tank is planted
The retailer says it may affect pH and hardness

fits.fact: JBL says it works in any freshwater tank and is meant for new setups.
A shop says it is safe for fish and shrimp.
It is not for marine tanks, since it is marketed only for freshwater.
It works under inert gravel or sand, or under aquasoils such as JBL Manado, ADA Amazonia II, Akadama or Contro Soil.
A local blog says plants absorb its micronutrients faster when it is paired with JBL Ferropol 24 liquid fertiliser.

usage.fact: Spread it on the bare tank bottom first, then cover it with washed substrate.
Make the base layer about 2 cm deep.
Cover it with 4–6 cm of washed 2–3 mm gravel or another substrate.
If the top layer is aquasoil, keep it under about 5 cm.
Always add a top layer. Uncovered base can leak into the water column and harm fish, shrimp and plants.
Mixing in lava rock keeps the base layer airy.
Add water once it is covered and set up the tank as normal. Use the amount suited to your tank volume.
It comes pre-mixed with sand, so it clouds the water less than powder bases like JBL Florapol.

issues.fact: Shops disagree on how big a tank one bag covers: 64–100 l or about 180 l for the 2.5 l bag, and 200 l or about 300 l for the 5 l bag. Buyers should check this against JBL's own instructions.
Lifespan claims also vary: JBL says 5 years, while some Vietnamese shops say at least 3 years depending on plant density.
Some reviewers said it was too early to tell whether the long-term fertilising effect was worth the money. Ratings were still high, at 4.8/5 from 6 reviews.
Stock looks limited at some Vietnamese shops. Both sizes showed sold-out badges on two shop pages.
The retailer's support team says it can change pH and hardness, so watch water parameters after setup.

alternatives.why: Cheaper JBL base, about 145,000 VND per box for about 100 l, with similar micronutrients and a 3+ year life. It is a fine powder that clouds easily, and plants can run short of nutrients under strong light or with heavy water changes.
Not a base by itself: Manado has no nutrients. It is usually layered over AquaBasis plus or Florapol to stabilise water and anchor roots, and it must be rinsed first.
A comparable premium mineral base from Germany, sold in several sizes (2.4 / 4.8 / 9.6 kg). Dennerle claims it can last up to about 10 years. I couldn't confirm a Vietnamese shop price.
